description: This file defines a test logger class for the PSR Log package, used for capturing and verifying log records during testing.

classes.name: TestLogger
classes.description: A testing implementation of a logger that records all log messages, enabling verification within tests.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Records a log message with specified level, message, and context.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for various log level checks; maps method names to internal functions.

methods.name: hasRecords
methods.description: Checks if any records exist at a specified level.

methods.name: hasRecord
methods.description: Checks if a specific record exists at a given level.

methods.name: hasRecordThatContains
methods.description: Checks if any record message contains a specified substring at a given level.

methods.name: hasRecordThatMatches
methods.description: Checks if any record message matches a regex at a given level.

methods.name: hasRecordThatPasses
methods.description: Checks if any record at a level passes a custom predicate.
